notes.title: Midnight Guns - Patch Notes - Alpha 0.5.2
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/bb31dace682f6ee3a602d60a1a85efb60aeac407.png"] Balance Changes
The last month of pickups have sparked a lot of conversation about the merits and demerits of different loadouts. We're working on a big change to how Kevlar and Helmets work (stay tuned), but in the meantime the following changes have been made:  

 Conc-Bombs now have an even shorter wind-up. 

 Conc-Bombs now have a slightly longer throw range.

 Conc-Bombs can now blow up in your hands, so don't cook them too long! 

 Concussive Shots have reduced viewkick. 

 The MP5 now gets less spread penalty from movement, and has had a ~6% damage buff.

 The M202 Flash rockets have gotten a speed bump. 

 The Grenade Pistol has been brought down a peg, with reduced knockback, base damage, and aoe radius. Also, the drop animation can no longer be canceled after firing.

 Dynamite throwables have consequently gotten a damage and aoe radius bump!

 Throwing Knives have had both a hitbox size increase and a base damage increase.

 Both the Pipe and Hockey Stick have gotten damage bumps.



Most importantly, rounds that time-out will now consistently result in a draw, instead of the most-HP mechanics from before. 



Harlem Updates
Harlem now has additional paths opened up to the Warehouse Roof, between Apartments and Garage, and up to Sniper Roof! Sniper Roof itself has been nerfed a little bit by some new construction on the Warehouse, obscuring more of the rooftop.

notes.title: Midnight Guns - Patch Notes - Alpha 0.5.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/bbc213f1ed61b711fc26e0fd384a2ba4cae1cb7d.png
New Callvote Options
Gamemode Variants
In 0.5.1 we've added our first iteration of player-controlled gamemode settings. We've removed `cv competitive` and replaced it with `cv rules NAME`. Valid rulesets are `default, comp, 2v2, 1v1`

Comp: Default competitive 4v4 you know and (probably) love.
2v2: 5 minute halfs, shorter rounds.
1v1: 3 minute halfs, short rounds.

Team Shuffle
`cv shuffle` now scrambles teams randomly, and leaves spectators alone unlike the old method.

Bench/Forcespec
`cv bench NAME` forces a player to spectate. Useful for any pesky AFK NA players.


Accessibility Options
Highlight Fill
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/cc11403538b0e69afd3992187d3ba8dab214ee77.png
This option fills in any outlined object by tinting the interior with the outline color, it lowers contrast but may help some people with visibility.

Dim World
https://imgsli.com/MzI5ODUw


Dim Teammates
https://imgsli.com/MzI5ODQ5


And More!
A experimental color blindness mode was also added, alongside a much-request darker concussion effect to stop you from being blinded while sitting in your dark gamer dungeon.

Balance Changes
We also made a myriad of balance changes, I'll summarize some highlights below.

 Conc-Bombs now have a shorter wind-up.
 Conc-Bombs now have a slightly longer throw range.
 Sniper no-scope inaccuracy was increased from 12 -> 14.
 Round timelimit decreased from 110s -> 105s
 Super items can now spawn between 50s - 30s instead of a fixed spawn time at 35s 


Bug Fixes & Misc
This patch includes a ton of bug fixes to food and super items. We've also enhanced the blockbuster/super items indicators to make them less visually intrusive.

notes.title: Midnight Guns - Alpha 0.5.0 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/563e662e771573b55982a1383a7460f3e0af7306.png

This is a big one! We've had a couple more core gameplay mechanics to implement, and it so happens that they landed at the same time. Check out the deets below!

New Mechanic: Power Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/bd485735169fb428a613234d4b7c0f5df1f0d0a2.png
Meet CarrierBot!
Max Mega has "recruited" these automatons to deliver high ordinance if he starts itching for more action. If there is a 1v1 or a 1v2 in the final 30 seconds of the round, CarrierBot will spawn and deliver one from a pool of Power Items! Currently, the pool contains the following:

X-Ray Spex
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/1f226d80baa72eb2f5d2c78bc2379b182b401abf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/af09d75079bc1c4c4b897f6eb62110fb479977ec.png
Using the Food slot, activate these glasses to peer through the materium and flush out your opponents!  5 1-second charges are available, so use it both strategically and tactically.

Stealth Boots
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/a971f2710e6e676a24711f7056bd2ea96f44a00a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/349431820561bccd38c6b03795c8136b25280307.png
Now you too can be ninja! This A-Slot Gear masks your footsteps, and when not moving, will even cloak you in shadows (or at least a neat dithering effect). Note that you're allowed to shoot from cloak as well, so get evil with it!

M202 Flash
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/0f9bc025198794d79b9456f51fb439edd6c15cdc.png
The Itano Circus is finally in town! A volley of four semi-guided-semi-intelligent-semi-volatile rockets will burst out of this launcher, immolating everyone vaguely in the direction you're pointed!

New Mechanic: Food
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/114d6fbc89ba6d8d5f67262b63cb870ea0e0db7c.png
When exploring a shattered New York, you may come across soggy pizza in a dumpster or an irradiated burger in the sewers. What should you do? Snarf it down, naturally! Food is our form of activated powerups - currently you'll be able to find Pizza, Burgers, and Chicken scattered around the maps, and in future updates you'll also find Calcium Shots that will act as a shield to fall damage, and Beer bottles that will double as a throwing weapon! Dig in!

New Throwable: Conc Bomb
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/170b397526fd4ca8cfabb45b1ea21eb371498652.png
We'd never recommend doing anything like this at home, but video games are fine! Give your enemies a real whizz bang with this soda-and-dry-ice combo. Affected enemies (and friends!) will be flashed, given inverted controls, and fire randomly during the duration of the effect. Very handy when flushing out campers, or sending you straight to the ER!

The Conc Bomb can also be equipped as a B-Slot Gear, replacing the Radio for the time being.

Harlem Visual Update Part One
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/267a38c62a5a0983a95cddc77bbbcc013644edf6.png
Harlem has been with us for a while, and a lot of lessons have been learned about our intended art direction, color balance, and theming. There's a lot more work to be done on Harlem, but this is a start that will lend some aids to visibility. Oh and also, the route to the Warehouse Roof got a little trickier. ;)


Balance Changes

 Sniper Rifle has been given a slight spread when unscoped, even when stationary. Use the laser to mitigate this!
 The Carbine's "Small Caliber" damage flag has been tweaked to bring helmet, torso, and leg damage scaling more in line with other weapons.

notes.title: Midnight Guns - Alpha 0.4.0 & 0.4.1 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/4170c9a16c6cb281201e434537e5dc98640e277a.png

New Mechanic: Concussion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/1212927646c297658d3f86b594f3e1b174235dd8.png
For 0.4.1, Reki added a new mechanic which is triggered when severe blunt-force or head trauma is inflicted. Your vision closes in for a moment and your crosshair position wobbles. This will most commonly be seen when getting headshot by a high damage weapon while wearing a helmet, activating a tourniquet, or when getting hit with a Lead Pipe. The Stabilizing Frustum B-Slot Item prevents all concussion from damage by virtue of its luxurious padding.

Input Overlay
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/698784836cb090d97e7c43d9491d25a2d87dea34.png
A long requested feature, we finally got around to adding an Input overlay for spectators or streamers to show their inputs on screen. Currently residing in the bottom right hand side of the UI, eventually it will become movable to different parts of the HUD similarly to the Hit Indicators

New STG-44 Model
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/776b5b5803ee1aaea72c3946866c281db21aa8ca.png
The STG-44 has been one of our last remaining placeholder models for quite some time, and for this patch it finally gets a facelift. Lovingly modeled by Grimm, textured by Jehar, and animated by Reki, this has been the first model passed through this workflow and will hopefully be the first of many.

LCA Protection Effect
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/94d3f7eb134fce885c480bbbf8cd81783995d718.png
There is a new visual effect representing when players are invulnerable, with a hologram effect surrounding the player. The hologram is colored based on the gang (and palette) of the player who is protected.

Balance Changes
After Turf Wars, we decided some balance tweaks were in order.
Highlights include:
Hockey-Sticks and Pipes will now break legs if inflicting over 50 damage
M4 long-range damage lowered from 35% to 30%
Pistol long-range damage increased from 25% to 35%
Graph of the current weapon damage curves

Boot-Sector wins Turf Wars Season 1!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/0472a86c2a7c0e6c8dd00f1bbfdf44227f42101d.png
Turf Wars concluded last weekend, with Boot-Sector coming out on top! Congratulations to ckap and his team for putting on an impressive display and mounting a comeback in the final week. 0.4.1 includes the Desert Eagle | Turf Wars as a congratulatory skin for the winning team.




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/22678c5c843d23e36d93cd63deb3a1d92dbfd349.png

New Gamemode: Blockbuster
It's a bit early for us to do a proper big announcement, but Classy and Jehar have been hard at work bringing a more casual gamemode to the Midnight Guns roster. Blockbuster is a variant of Capture the Flag, featuring a single "flag" in the form of a VHS tape that must be stolen from one Bot and delivered to another.

TooUrban Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/164daf1f74e4544c0c161a25d3e1a69c307a1b13.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/06c1b36418ecaec3b8c60b9a5c19c4df287a3a49.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/deb9f2f63a097028dbfe6453f2105a3386ca1484.png
Jehar has continued to tweak TooUrban, and 0.4.0 came with an overhaul of much of the map. "Derzie"/King Construction has seen a significant layout change, and Classio has seen continued reworking.

New Pistol Model
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/07fca6796c34190d3d9f1ec7b9edc22083946610.png
Grimm cooked up a new Pistol model to replace our old M1911 placeholder, with jehar doing the rigging and texturing.

New Skins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/8047b0db5187c8f41a6387c256a787a69e02d115.png
Grimm and Jehar brought a few new skins to the game, including a Desert Eagle magnum skin and a new Spas-12 variant, among others!

notes.title: Midnight Guns - Alpha 0.3.0 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New Map: TooUrban
Last month Jehar got to work porting a beloved AQ2 map: urban2. It's currently not fully arted, but it's ready for a fresh coat of blood to put it through its paces.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/e8b2a31ec771c89369a2b4d7991f7efdc3968cd8.pngIt's urban, also

New UI System
Reki and Classy have spent the last several months overhauling and replacing the existing UI framework with a new, more flexible solution. Alongside this Jehar has been making new designs and assets for a more polished look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/a0f3c5995471de2b52afe591d57ef64b8f5a5ded.pngOoo, aaah, shiny

What this means for you
You get a nice shiny UI! Which makes way for upcoming important game mechanics. Woohoo. The downside of ripping out and replacing a large chunk of the existing game's code means a lot of older legacy gamemodes no-longer work properly. Currently we are only officially supporting Action and Jump, but after QuakeCon we will be working diligently to restore and revamp the rest of the gamemode roster.


New Skins
This update features new skins and revamped existing skins/models. This nearly concludes our replacement of fully-placeholder weapon models in the game. While not all of these assets represent our final vision for the art direction, they at least are a large step in the right direction. Grimm was hard at work last month making a new MP5 mesh, and Jehar textured and animated it to replace our existing placeholder.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/518a89d046b04d603492fcff7abbb8d5d185909b.pngOur new lovely blue MP5A4

Additionally this update includes our celebratory "Generations" skins, which were available to patrons purchasing swag packs at QuakeCon 2024. This set features the debut of the iconic CAR-15 replacement for the Assault Rifle, for all you nostalgic M4ers out there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/3aaa50aa66ad1e6be77403d54d8285cd3c367200.pngYou snooze, you lose

notes.title: Midnight Guns - Alpha 0.2.9a - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Strato Layout Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/7e92944f107e23de2e5afcd324248377a8523c64.png
oooo, nice pipe

Last patch we introduced a new roof on Strato, and there's been some feedback about how powerful that position could be, and how difficult it is to contest it from the outside spawn. These new changes include an extension of the vent, to now serve as a new main lane in the map, and relatively easy access to the roof from outside spawn.

New Grenade Pistol
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/815dbdc71064e43f2416b56ebd1303fa35b04e52.gif
totally tubular

Continuing our fight to replace all of our long-standing placeholders, the grenade pistol has received its own unique model. This baby was cooked up by Grimm, and textured/animated by Jehar. Along with these new animations is an extension of the auto-drop timer, so make sure you remember to chuck it manually if you need to swap quick.

New Magnum
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/9594a9f7194b5768a8d1250504337ec07c47307f.gif
Magnum, PI

As previously mentioned, Grimm has been cooking up a new Magnum to fit our new five-shot capacity, and here it is. It comes loaded with five rounds of .400 Nitro Express, ready to blow grapefruit sized holes in anything you point it at.

In Other News
Wallkick Fixes!
Last patch wallkicks got a little funky. We've continued our iteration and bug-fixing, and have removed the triple wallkick bug (sorry folks). We have however slightly increased the base vertical boost to account for the removal of downward view angle boosting. This should be more user-friendly since staring at the floor now gives no benefit, which overall aids consistency and removes confusing behavior.

Modding Framework Progress
Over the last week Reki and Classy have begun work on a new UI system, which will be the first of several enhancements to the overall modularity and moddability of the base game. This system is planned to allow modders to create entirely new huds and menus without requiring modification of the base game code.

notes.title: Midnight Guns - Alpha 0.2.9 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Revamped Strato Layout
As we move towards a finalized layout for Strato, we decided to make some changes to add some connectivity to the map. New windows have been carved in banana, and a rooftop in upper mid. You'll have to find some clever ways to get to mid-roof from the outside spawn, get boostin!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/27faf371fcbeba5dc1cc61a29c5e9b1cb2d16720.gif
view of mid-roof from top lifts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/64f9d1fe0bc5c26dbcd65d855de981af4cd306ae.gif
view of banana and catwalk, with the new broken railings to promote jumping through windows

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/6f90d157cf763830f2942573adc4443b789e13e5.gif
view of mid-roof and banana windows from outside

New Assault Rifle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42947727/abedcf971947bd42d19e30a8a707207c99394d94.png AR with action mag and suppressor

Replacing our 3 (three!) year old M4 model is a new M16A1 inspired AR. We wanted to give it more of a prototype look to nod towards its inaccurate bullet-hose gameplay style. This is the first official model by our new modeler Grimm, who has offered to do some modeling work for the team.

New Rat
https://i.imgur.com/CK6kc4e.gif
no! poor Stuart :(

Everybody say goodbye to Twinkie Rat™, and say hello to Stuart! He has some fun additional features. Be warned, he's pretty slippery so hold on to your weapons if someone happens to throw him at you!

New Bandaging
https://i.imgur.com/uc9lO9j.gif
jazz hands!

There is now first and third person bandaging animations, along with a sound. Beware, this means enemies can now see and hear (at very close range) when you are bandaging. This is a large change behind the scenes in how we handle bandaging, which paves the way for our upcoming consumable slot. Consumables will be found in the world, and allow healing and other special effects.


In Other News
The Team Expands!
Over the last month, our small team got a little less-small. As alluded to in the AR section, we gained a part-time modeler in Grimm. Additionally, Classy has joined our team as a volunteer programmer helping Reki clean up some of the particularly egregious crusty old code which has remained from the earliest prototype stages of the game.

Magnum Changes
Magnum got some range buffs, with falloff having a more graceful curve. It also now has 5 bullets per clip-a-cylinder-zine instead of 4. Grimm has been working a wonderful new revolver-style model for our Magnum based on the menu art, which will act as the new default skin, but it didn't quite make it in for this update.

Midnight Revolution Changes
Midnight Revolution got some fancy new grass, which is our first testing into tessellation shaders. This may misbehave on pre-OpenGL 4.2 graphics cards, so feedback and bug reports would be greatly appreciated especially with older hardware. Additionally the map got a facelift with some new textures and an addition of a clock on what the community has started to call *Clock* Tower.

Sniper Changes
After what some would perhaps call a "nerfing into the ground" the Sniper is back. Despite still enjoying viability on most maps, we felt the aim-punch was a bit too punishing and felt cheap when getting hit with only a couple bullets. This patch drastically reduces aim-punch, tho it is still present.

Wallkick Changes
originally omitted, added June 10th
Wallkicks have been changed to be more forgiving on vertical view angles, while also not allowing downward wallkicks. Additionally the vertical portion of the kick boost has been lowered when falling at speed, to discourage last second saves from extreme falls. This will be an ongoing process and wallkicking will continue to be tweaked over future updates.

Map Entities
Classy has been hard at work refactoring the old entities to use OOP, and generally cleaning up QuakeC jank. In conjunction with this we've added a new entity "func_wall" which can be toggled on/off by targeting it, an entity which as become ubiquitous in Quake mods. Additionally a whole host of Work In Progress "logic_*" entities have been added, which can act as a low-fi virtual machine for you to do more advanced entity scripting with.

Map Scripting
Technically added last update, maps are now allowed to load their own QuakeC .dat files. Much like Gamemode scripting this allows maps to add their own entities and behavior to the game without requiring a separate mod or constant maintenance to keep it up to date with the main game.

As always if you need help with modding/mapping, feel free to join our Discord and drop a message in the #mapping-modding channel.
